nodes.title: Create project package manifest with React, Vite, and Recharts dependencies
nodes.task: Write package.json with scripts for dev, build, and preview. Include dependencies: react, react-dom, recharts. Include devDependencies: vite, @vitejs/plugin-react, typescript, tailwindcss, postcss, autoprefixer, and relevant type packages for React.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: package.json is valid JSON; includes react and react-dom in dependencies; includes vite and @vitejs/plugin-react in devDependencies; includes recharts dependency; scripts support local development and production build.

nodes.title: Define TypeScript compiler configuration
nodes.task: Write tsconfig.json targeting ES2022, using module settings compatible with Vite, enabling strict mode, DOM libs, module resolution suitable for bundlers, and jsx set to react-jsx.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: tsconfig.json is valid JSON; target is ES2022; jsx is react-jsx; configuration supports src TypeScript and TSX files without legacy React import requirements.

nodes.title: Add Tailwind CSS configuration
nodes.task: Write a JSON-based Tailwind config equivalent containing content globs for index.html and src/**/*.{ts,tsx}, and extend theme minimally for dashboard spacing or colors if needed.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: Tailwind config is valid JSON; content paths include src TS/TSX files; theme is usable for dashboard styling without external dependencies.

nodes.title: Add PostCSS configuration for Tailwind processing
nodes.task: Write a JSON PostCSS config that enables tailwindcss and autoprefixer plugins.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: postcss.config.json is valid JSON; tailwindcss and autoprefixer are configured as plugins.

nodes.title: Create global stylesheet with Tailwind layers and dashboard base styles
nodes.task: Write src/index.css with Tailwind base, components, and utilities directives. Add body/root defaults for full-height layout, neutral dashboard background, text color, and overflow-x hidden to help prevent horizontal scrolling on small screens.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: CSS includes Tailwind directives; app fills viewport height; default styles support a clean dashboard appearance; no forced horizontal overflow is introduced.

nodes.title: Centralize dashboard mock data and shared types
nodes.task: Define TypeScript types/interfaces for navigation items, metrics, trend points, category chart data, and activity items. Export at least 4 navigation items, 3 metrics, 7 trend data points, category distribution data for a second chart, and at least 5 activity records with timestamps. Make some fields optional in types to support fallback rendering.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: Module exports all static datasets needed by the UI; includes at least 4 nav items, 3 metrics, 2 chart datasets, and 5 activities; data is typed; optional fields are represented in types to support safe rendering.

nodes.title: Implement responsive sidebar navigation component
nodes.task: Create a functional Sidebar component with typed props for items, selected item id, and onSelect callback. Render at least a branding section and nav buttons. Apply active/inactive styles, truncate long labels safely, and support desktop vertical layout plus small-screen horizontal/top layout using Tailwind responsive classes.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: Component renders branding and nav items from props; clicking an item calls onSelect with the item id; selected item is visually highlighted; long labels do not break layout; layout can switch responsively without horizontal overflow.

nodes.title: Implement dashboard header component
nodes.task: Create a functional Header component with optional subtitle/support info props and sensible defaults. Render a title, short supporting copy, and a simple avatar placeholder or welcome block. Use responsive flex wrapping so content never overlaps on smaller screens.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: Header shows title and auxiliary area; optional props have defaults; narrow layouts wrap instead of overlapping; component remains visually consistent with dashboard styling.

nodes.title: Implement KPI cards section with empty state
nodes.task: Create a functional component that accepts an array of metrics. Render title, main value, and change text for each card using fallback values when fields are missing. If the array is empty or undefined, show a styled 'No metrics available' message instead of cards.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: At least 3 cards can render from provided data; each card shows label, value, and change text; empty input renders 'No metrics available'; missing fields do not cause runtime errors.

nodes.title: Implement charts section using Recharts with per-chart empty states
nodes.task: Create a functional component that accepts two datasets. Use ResponsiveContainer and Recharts primitives to render a 7-day line chart and a second chart type such as BarChart or PieChart with legend/axes where applicable. If either dataset is empty or undefined, render a chart card with placeholder text instead of the chart. Guard all property access with safe fallbacks.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: Two chart cards are rendered; one uses a line chart and one uses a different chart type; chart axes and/or legend are visible when data exists; empty datasets show placeholder text without console/rendering errors; charts are responsive and fit their containers.

nodes.title: Implement recent activity feed with sorting and empty state
nodes.task: Create a functional component that accepts activity items, sorts them descending by timestamp, and renders title, description/status, and time. Use fallback labels for missing fields. If input is empty or undefined, display 'No recent activity'.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: At least 5 activities can render; records are displayed in descending timestamp order; each item includes title, details, and time; empty input renders 'No recent activity'; undefined optional fields do not crash rendering.

nodes.title: Compose responsive dashboard layout structure
nodes.task: Create a layout component with typed props for sidebar and main content sections. Arrange desktop layout as a sidebar plus content area. Inside main content, position metrics first, then charts and activity in a responsive grid that becomes single-column on smaller screens. Ensure no horizontal overflow at widths like 1440, 1024, 768, and 375.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: Desktop shows sidebar and main content side by side; smaller screens switch to a stacked or top-nav layout; charts/activity align cleanly without overlap; component acts as a reusable shell for the dashboard page.

nodes.title: Assemble dashboard page in App with local navigation state
nodes.task: Implement App as the single dashboard page. Use useState to track the selected nav id and pass data into Sidebar, Header, MetricCards, ChartsSection, and RecentActivity through DashboardLayout. Keep all behavior local with no routing or network requests.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: App renders the complete dashboard with sidebar, header, metrics, charts, and activity feed; clicking nav items updates the active highlight and only one item is active at a time; all data comes from the local mock module.

nodes.title: Create Vite React entry point
nodes.task: Write src/main.tsx using ReactDOM.createRoot to render <App /> inside the #root element and import src/index.css.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: main.tsx renders App to #root; imports global CSS; uses React 18 createRoot API; contains no unnecessary logic.

nodes.title: Review implementation coverage against dashboard acceptance criteria
nodes.task: Review the implemented files and confirm each acceptance criterion is covered: visible dashboard regions, local nav highlighting, 3+ metrics, metric/chart/activity empty states, two Recharts visualizations, descending activity sort, responsive layout at desktop and small screens, safe optional field fallbacks, and separated components for Sidebar, Header, MetricCards, ChartsSection, RecentActivity, and DashboardLayout.
nodes.acceptanceCriteria: Reviewer can map every acceptance criterion to a corresponding file and behavior; no duplicate ownership of bootstrap files exists; all output files are unique and valid extensions; the implementation is ready to run as a Vite React TypeScript dashboard.
